subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: ISO 14001 Certification
description: A fast breakdown of ISO 14001 Certification for builders.

hook.text: A supplier displays an ISO 14001 certificate. It means their environmental management meets an international standard.

buildup.text: ISO 14001 is the global standard for environmental management systems (EMS) in organizations.

discovery.text: It requires companies to identify environmental impacts, set targets, and continuously improve performance.

twist.text: Certification doesn't guarantee low emissions. It guarantees a system to manage them. Execution varies.

climax.text: Many large buyers now require ISO 14001 from suppliers as a minimum environmental qualification.

punchline.text: ISO 14001 is the baseline, not the finish line.
